run_PatchTSTModel: run the PatchTSTModel encoder on time series past values to get hidden state representations
build_PatchTSTForPretraining: build a PatchTSTForPretraining model for masked patch pretraining on multivariate time series
train_PatchTSTForPrediction: train a PatchTSTForPrediction model to forecast future time series values from past observations
classify_PatchTSTForClassification: classify time series sequences using PatchTSTForClassification with configurable pooling and cls token
regress_PatchTSTForRegression: regress time series inputs to continuous target values using PatchTSTForRegression with optional distribution output
